fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Aboleth
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Ancient race of fish-like amphibians with three eyes and four tentacles
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Aboleth

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Advi, Avenger
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A 1-foot diameter sphere with four knife-like legs and a single large 'eye'
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Advi, Avenger

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Advi, Charity
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A sphere of silvery metal with dozens of small protrusions that glow a faint orange
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Advi, Charity

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Advi, Diligence
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A 1-foot diameter sphere of silvery metal with eight appendages
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Advi, Diligence

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Aergian Amalgamation
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A violent creature formed from failed adventurers' souls, resembling four monstrous hands with six tentacle-like appendages
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Aergian Amalgamation

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Aerial Servant
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: An invisible extra-dimensional creature summoned to acquire and transport objects or creatures
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Aerial Servant

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Aeromi
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Fur-covered arboreal humanoid with gliding membrane and long bushy tail
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Aeromi

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Aghar
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A race of manlike creatures from the Elemental Realm of Earth, large beings 10 to 11 feet in height weighing around 1,500 pounds
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Aghar

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Aghlorv
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Six-legged, hairless cat-like creature with scaly skin and barbed spines
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Aghlorv

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Allip
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Spectral undead form left behind by a suicide, still afflicted by madness
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Allip

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Alokin
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Alien creature with rubbery reddish skin that stands about 4 feet tall
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Alokin

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Amalgam
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Huge undead formed from multiple spirits mingling together, appearing as clouds of mist, floating eyes, shadow figures, or blue flames
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Amalgam

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Amarok
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Lupine humanoid that forms packs and hunts wilderness areas
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Amarok

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Ankheg
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Large insect-like monster with a taste for fresh meat that burrows beneath forests and farmlands
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Ankheg

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Ant Lion, Giant
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A gigantic predatory beetle about the size of a cow that builds underground tunnel networks with trapdoor ambushes
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Ant Lion, Giant

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Anubian
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Noble race of desert dwelling humanoids with jackal heads
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Anubian

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Apatosapien
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Bipedal, intelligent dinosaur descended from giant herbivores
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Apatosapien

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Ape, Bonobo
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A less aggressive and more social member of the ape family, closely related to common chimpanzees
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Ape, Bonobo

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Ape, Carnivorous Snow
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Larger variety of carnivorous ape with shaggy snow-white fur
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Ape, Carnivorous Snow

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Ape, Chimpanzee
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Short but strong ape, generally herbivorous but will eat fresh meat
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Ape, Chimpanzee

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Ape, Gigantopithecus
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Prehistoric gorillas, huge and powerful
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Ape, Gigantopithecus

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Ape, Girallon
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Savage, four-armed, magical cousins of the gorilla
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Ape, Girallon

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Ape, Gorilla
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Generally herbivorous apes, aggressive mainly in defense of family
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Ape, Gorilla

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Ape, Orangutan
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Shy but powerful primates, heavier and stronger than humans
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Ape, Orangutan

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Ape, Winged
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Carnivorous ape with bat-like wings sprouting from its back
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Ape, Winged

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Aranea
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Intelligent, shape-changing, spider-like creature with magical abilities
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Aranea

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Armorollo
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Pack creature with rock-colored plates that rolls across grasslands at high speed
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Armorollo

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Armorphage
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A magical parasite whose body outwardly appears to be an elaborate, ornamental suit of armor
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Armorphage

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Aurumvorax
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Eight-legged mustelid the size of a medium dog with a thick gold coat
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Aurumvorax

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Avir
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Anthropomorphic birds who live in mountain settlements
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Avir

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Awful Offal
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A disgusting heap of viscous organ matter and entrails, the unnaturally animated remains of a humanoid separated from its skin and skeleton
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Awful Offal

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Axolotl, Giant
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A paedomorphic salamander that matures without undergoing metamorphosis into the terrestrial adult form
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Axolotl, Giant

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Baboon
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: An aggressive primate adapted to life on the ground
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Baboon

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Badger
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Squat and broad, muscular, burrowing mammals with iron hard digging claws
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Badger

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bagobone, Aquatic
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Creature made from seal skin with a great white shark head and polar bear claws
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bagobone, Aquatic

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bagobone, Forest
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Made from the skin of a moose or buffalo with bear claws and a lion's head
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bagobone, Forest

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Baldander
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Marine shapeshifter that assumes the form and abilities of creatures it kills
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Baldander

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Balroach
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A variety of giant cockroach larger than a horse
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Balroach

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Baluchitherium
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Giant prehistoric animal, the largest land mammal to ever exist
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Baluchitherium

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Banshee
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Fey undead resembling a colorless, ash-white elf in ragged clothing and chains
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Banshee

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Barghest
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: An evil shape-changing fiend that hungers for the souls of mortals
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Barghest

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Barkgheist
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Spirit of a person killed by a dog, appearing as a large black dog with fiery red eyes
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Barkgheist

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Barrode
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Humanoid scavengers with orange skin, ruffled ears, and a tactical approach to combat
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Barrode

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bat, Giant Flying Fox
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A carnivorous giant bat similar to jungle fruit bats but much larger
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bat, Giant Flying Fox

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bear, Battle
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Large bear with hardened bone plates and four arms wielding spears
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bear, Battle

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bear, Dream
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A phantasmal black bear, hazy and partially transparent with misty currents visible within it
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bear, Dream

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bear, Ghost
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: An undead semi-corporeal bear with a fear-inducing roar
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bear, Ghost

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bear, Long
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: An abomination created by botched growth magic, over 30 feet long with a dozen legs
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bear, Long

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bear, Migou
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A bizarre, magical bear-like predator with humanoid-like hind paws and the ability to bewitch its prey
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bear, Migou

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bear, Quill
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A large bear with long, razor-sharp spikes covering its back and sides
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bear, Quill

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bear, Ursine Behemoth
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A rare bear of truly gargantuan size, 20 to 30 feet tall when standing upright
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bear, Ursine Behemoth

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Beaver, Giant
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Huge versions of the ordinary aquatic mammal, often found in "lost world" areas
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Beaver, Giant

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Beebear
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A light brown bear with black stripes, insect-like wings, and a stinger tail
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Beebear

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Beetle, Giant Bombardier
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Red and black beetle, 3 to 4 feet long, with toxic spray attack
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Beetle, Giant Bombardier

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Beetle, Giant Boring
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Giant beetles that eat rotting wood and operate like a hive collective
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Beetle, Giant Boring

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Beetle, Giant Fire
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Huge beetle with glowing red organs that provide illumination
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Beetle, Giant Fire

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Beetle, Giant Oil
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Giant beetle about 3 feet long with eyes that can see in all directions
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Beetle, Giant Oil

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Beetle, Giant Rhinoceros
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Largest of the giant beetles, between 10 and 14 feet long with brown or grey carapaces and huge horns
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Beetle, Giant Rhinoceros

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Beetle, Giant Stag
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Giant beetles with males possessing huge stag-like mandibles
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Beetle, Giant Stag

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Beetle, Giant Tiger
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Predatory monsters around 5 feet long with dark brown carapaces and lighter striped or spotted patterns
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Beetle, Giant Tiger

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Beetle, Giant Water
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Round-bodied beetles found in deep fresh water, attracted by vibrations or noise
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Beetle, Giant Water

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Behir
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A serpentine monster with a dozen legs that can slither like a snake or move with considerable speed
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Behir

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bestomper
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A giant levitating foot with eyes on each toe and a slobbering mouth on its ball
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bestomper

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bisren
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A bison-headed humanoid nomad, related to minotaurs but uniformly hybridized
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bisren

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Black Knight
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A cursed heroic warrior transformed into an undead skeleton with burning coal eyes, retaining its honor and combat prowess
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Black Knight

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Blade Spirit
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Tormented souls of fallen warriors bound to their weapons in undeath
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Blade Spirit

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bloodshroud
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A floating man covered in a bed sheet, soaked in dripping fresh blood
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bloodshroud

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bloodthorn
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Rare carnivorous plants native to temperate forests, hills, and barrens
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bloodthorn

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Boar, Polar
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Large boar covered in thick white fur and blubber, adapted to extreme cold
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Boar, Polar

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Boar, Sewer
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Distant relative of the wild boar that lives underground in dungeons or sewers
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Boar, Sewer

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bodach
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A huge hairy goblin-like creature with green complexion that stands up to seven feet tall
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bodach

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bog Crone
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A loathsome and repugnant fey who dwells in marshlands, swamps, and other watery environs
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bog Crone

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Boggart
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A creature of unknown true form that feeds on fear and can project terrifying illusions
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Boggart

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Boglin
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Goblins born with bluish skin who develop magical abilities
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Boglin

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bone Chimera
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: An abominable undead monster composed of the skeletons of several different species
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bone Chimera

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bone Horror
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Terrifying undead constructed from the bones of multiple creatures, animated by dark necromancy
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bone Horror

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bone Viper
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: An animated, undead snake skeleton
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bone Viper

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Botanical
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A plant creature that closely resembles humans in size and form
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Botanical

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Brain Parasite
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A 1-inch long vermin found in carrion, dung, and other organic material that burrows into the brain
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Brain Parasite

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Brazen Sphere Imprisoner
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: The rarest manifestation of brazen spheres, an 8-foot tall sphere that imprisons solitary intruders
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Brazen Sphere Imprisoner

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Brazen Sphere Major
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: The most formidable construct that the spheres can assemble, an imposing humanoid monstrosity standing at a towering 12 feet
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Brazen Sphere Major

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Brazen Sphere Minor
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A humanoid construct standing 6 feet tall with two bludgeon-like arms
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Brazen Sphere Minor

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Brazen Sphere Recombinant
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: The least powerful form of Brazen Sphere constructs
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Brazen Sphere Recombinant

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bronze Bird
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A crane-like water fowl with metallic feathers that dwells in regions of extreme heat
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bronze Bird

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Brown Mold
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A fungus that feeds on light and warmth, causing cold damage to nearby creatures
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Brown Mold

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Brownie
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A small fey being closely related to pixies and sprites, an elf-like creature about 2 feet tall
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Brownie

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bruhl
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Feral proto-human similar to a neanderthal but smaller and more simian-like
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bruhl

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bubák
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Horrific creatures haunting remote fields and forgotten corners of the wilds
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bubák

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bulette
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Terrifying predator that resembles a gigantic armadillo crossed with a snapping turtle
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bulette

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Bunyip
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Large carnivorous lake-dwelling creature with dog-like face, large tusks, sturdy webbed feet, short otter-like fur, and bear-like body
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Bunyip

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cacophony
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A band of magically-animated instruments brought about by the lingering attachments of failed bards
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cacophony

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cactus Man
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Resembles a Saguaro cactus with arms and legs
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cactus Man

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cadaver
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A corporeal undead creature resembling a ghoul that subsists by eating the flesh of other undead creatures
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cadaver

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Canein
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Dog-like humanoids known for extreme loyalty and knight-like codes
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Canein

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cat Sith
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A large elven cat as big as a dog, black with a white half-moon on their chest
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cat Sith

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Catoblepas
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A fantastically ugly creature with a warthog-like face and body, a long neck, and a powerful tail ending in a bone club
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Catoblepas

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Catspider
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A scary creature that resembles a cat with eight legs and retractable fangs
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Catspider

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Celestial Charger
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Swift celestial steeds with shimmering white coats, golden manes and tails, and silver hooves
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Celestial Charger

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Celestial, Arbiter
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Majestic, towering figures with silver skin, golden hair, and four white feathered wings who render judgements impacting mortal and celestial realms
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Celestial, Arbiter

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Celestial, Ascended
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Once mortal beings elevated to celestial status through divine intervention or exceptional deeds
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Celestial, Ascended

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Celestial, Descendant
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Tall, attractive humans with wings, descended from celestial messengers who fell in love with mortals
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Celestial, Descendant

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Celestial, Egregor
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Very tall humanoid figures in unique elaborate armor with full helmets, watchers who ensure Celestial messengers never fall in love with humans
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Celestial, Egregor

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Celestial, Guardian
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Protectors of the faithful with the body of a lion, large white wings, and a human face
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Celestial, Guardian

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Celestial, Messenger
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: The least powerful of the true celestials, delivering messages from the gods to mortals
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Celestial, Messenger

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Celestial, Oracle
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Wisest members of the celestial hierarchy with the ability to see into the future
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Celestial, Oracle

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Celestial, Solar
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A zealous champion of justice appearing as a very tall and beautiful humanoid figure with golden eagle-like wings
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Celestial, Solar

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Celestial, Warden
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Very tall humanoid commanders in elaborate armor with large white swan wings
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Celestial, Warden

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Celestial, Watcher
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Enigmatic celestials tasked with observing the mortal realms to ensure balance and harmony are maintained
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Celestial, Watcher

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Changeling
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A fey creature switched with human infants, becoming increasingly ugly and deformed as its magic wears off
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Changeling

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Chasenet
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Brightly-colored ball of fluff that resembles a bed of flowers when sleeping
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Chasenet

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cheiropteran
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Bat-people of the deep under-dark with bugbear-like bodies and misshapen bat heads
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cheiropteran

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Chelonian
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Reptilian humanoids resembling long-necked snapping turtles inhabiting rivers and swamps
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Chelonian

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Chimera, Lesser
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A magical beast with the body of a lion, a goat head sprouting from its back, and a snake-headed tail
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Chimera, Lesser

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Choker
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A vicious little predator that lurks underground, grabbing prey with spiny-padded hands and feet
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Choker

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Chuhl
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Horrid 8-foot long abomination that looks like a cross between a serpent, a crab, and an insect
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Chuhl

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Chupacabra
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A nocturnal reptile with a row of spines running down its back that moves by hopping like a kangaroo
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Chupacabra

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cicada, Giant
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Peaceful, horse-sized insects concerned only with eating, mating, and singing
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cicada, Giant

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cloaker
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Almost impossible to distinguish from dark surroundings when resting, with glowing eyes, needle-sharp fangs, and a whip-like tail
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cloaker

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Clockwork Armature
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A massive forty-foot tall bronze device combining magical and mechanical arts
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Clockwork Armature

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Clockwork Skeleton
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A skeletal construct made of bronze powered by pulleys, coils, wires, and gears
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Clockwork Skeleton

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cockroach, Giant Ghoul
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Animated through foul magics, a ravenous undead monster seeking to devour all flesh
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cockroach, Giant Ghoul

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Corpse Abomination
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Huge ball of rotting flesh and bones held together with clay that rolls towards victims
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Corpse Abomination

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Couatl
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A powerful and legendary large serpent with feathered wings and shape-changing abilities
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Couatl

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cow Dragon
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A very rare species of mammalian oddity resembling enormous cattle with giant bat-like wings
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cow Dragon

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cragodile
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A crocodile with heavy stony hide that hunts waterway shallows
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cragodile

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Crawling Claw
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A type of undead creature created from a severed hand, used for menial chores to discrete killings
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Crawling Claw

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Crypt Dweller
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: An undead creature improperly buried or placed into a grave that has been desecrated or defiled
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Crypt Dweller

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Crystalline Egret
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A 5-foot tall white egret made entirely of ice
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Crystalline Egret

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cu-Sidhe
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: An elven breed of canine with bark-patterned fur and excellent camouflage
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cu-Sidhe

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cuhtli
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A large golden serpent with raven wings and a tail stinger, evil counterpart to the couatl
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cuhtli

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Cunning Cloak
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A length of fabric that can assume various shapes and colors to ambush prey
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Cunning Cloak

fabio:hasPart.schema:description: An undead skeletal war horse with tattered remnants of saddle and tack still clinging to exposed bones
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Skeletal Steed

fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Blood-red skeleton created through alchemy and necromancy that reanimates after destruction
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Skeleton, Crimson Bones

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Skeleton, Diseased
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Animated skeleton of a creature that died of disease, stronger than normal skeletons and capable of spreading infection
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Skeleton, Diseased

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Skeleton, Gellybone
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Skeletons with bones transformed into gelatinous material through magical procedure
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Skeleton, Gellybone

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Skeleton, Haunted Bones
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Animated skeleton inhabited by a malicious spirit, more intelligent and quick than ordinary skeletons
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Skeleton, Haunted Bones

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Skeleton, Lava Lake
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Undead fire giant skeleton filled with dangerous, constantly-aflame fluids
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Skeleton, Lava Lake

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Skeleton, Pitch

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Skeleton, Pitch

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Skerraxis
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: The embodiment of rage, hatred, and malice of a conjurer given form as a shadowy figure
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Skerraxis

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Skragg
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A smaller semi-aquatic relative of the common troll, stockier in appearance
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Skragg

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Skum
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Horrific humanoid creatures transformed by aboleths as their servants
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Skum

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Skunk, Giant
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Giant skunks that raid human communities and defend themselves with foul-smelling musk spray
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Skunk, Giant

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Slithering Tracker
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A transparent slime monster, similar in nature to the gelatinous cube but smaller and more amorphous
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Slithering Tracker

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Slug, Giant
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Truly huge slugs, 15 feet long, 8 feet wide, and around 5 feet thick
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Slug, Giant

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Slug, Spitting
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A gastropod generally about the size of a medium pig that can spit digestive acid
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Slug, Spitting

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Smouldergeist
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Humanoid-shaped accumulations of smog and heat with white-hot eyes
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Smouldergeist

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snail, Giant
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A great molluscoid creature with a hard shell covering most of its body
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snail, Giant

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snail, Giant Barb
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A slow creature with a 6-8 foot shell that can spit dagger-sized teeth
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snail, Giant Barb

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snail, Giant Cone
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: 4 to 6 feet high, extremely well-camouflaged and highly toxic
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snail, Giant Cone

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snail, Giant Pounder
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: The size of a large dog or pony, pounds the ground to locate burrows
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snail, Giant Pounder

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snake, Amphisbaena
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A huge fearsome serpent with a head at each end of its 10- to 15-foot body
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snake, Amphisbaena

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snake, Clockwork Razor
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Python with cruel clockwork sections fitted with razor-sharp blades
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snake, Clockwork Razor

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snake, Giant Rattlesnake
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Much enlarged versions of the normal rattlesnake, averaging 14' to 20' in length at adulthood
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snake, Giant Rattlesnake

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snake, Green Tree
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Arboreal, non-venomous snakes reaching up to 5 feet in length
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snake, Green Tree

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snake, Hoop
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Similar to a regular pit viper with a unique rolling attack method
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snake, Hoop

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snake, King Cobra
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Deadly and aggressive snakes with spreading hoods that make a growling noise
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snake, King Cobra

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snake, Rainbow
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A 6-foot long snake with body colored in seven rainbow segments
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snake, Rainbow

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snake, Uktena
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A great horned water serpent as big around as a tree trunk with a bright blazing crest
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snake, Uktena

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snake, Vampire
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A clumsy ground-dwelling snake with bat-like wings that drains blood from paralyzed victims
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snake, Vampire

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Snake, Vort
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Medium-sized venomous snake with a bright, contrasting crest
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Snake, Vort

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spellgoat
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A goat that casts random magical effects when disturbed
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spellgoat

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spellripper
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: An undead with its body fully inscribed with runes and sigils that glow with stored magic
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spellripper

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Sphinx, Androsphinx
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A sphinx with the head of a man, intelligent and generally friendly but fierce when provoked
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Sphinx, Androsphinx

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Sphinx, Criosphinx
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A sphinx with the head of a goat, not very intelligent and avaricious
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Sphinx, Criosphinx

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Sphinx, Gynosphinx
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Female variant of the sphinx with formidable claws but prefers to avoid conflict
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Sphinx, Gynosphinx

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Sphinx, Hieracosphinx
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Hawk-headed sphinx that is cruel and voracious
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Sphinx, Hieracosphinx

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spider, Giant Bola
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Giant spider the size of a pony that throws webbed nets at prey
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spider, Giant Bola

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spider, Giant Diving Bell
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A pony-sized spider that carries air underwater and crafts air-filled lairs
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spider, Giant Diving Bell

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spider, Giant Ice
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Horse-sized crystal-clear spider adapted to icy environments
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spider, Giant Ice

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spider, Giant Shrieking Tarantula
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A rare, aberrant form of giant tarantula about the size of a horse with red leg-joints
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spider, Giant Shrieking Tarantula

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spider, Giant Trapdoor
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A pony-sized spider that digs deep tunnels with camouflaged trapdoor entrances
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spider, Giant Trapdoor

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spider, Giant Water
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Semi-intelligent creatures that make underwater lairs and breathe air
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spider, Giant Water

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spider, Giant Wolf
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Swift hunting spider with natural camouflage, about 3 feet tall and 5 feet long
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spider, Giant Wolf

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spider, Humming
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A flat-shaped arachnid with elongated head and razor-sharp front legs that hum when attacking
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spider, Humming

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spider, Phase
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: An aggressive predator that can shift between tangible and intangible states
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spider, Phase

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spider, Steel
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A construct made of steel with jeweled eyes used by Magic-users to guard possessions
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spider, Steel

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spider, Time
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Pony-sized spider with iridescent translucent crystalline black body and hourglass markings
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spider, Time

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Spirit of Vengeance
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Shadowy armored warrior formed of mists and blue flame, seeking vengeance for grave betrayal
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Spirit of Vengeance

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Strix

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Strix

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Sun's Child

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Sun's Child

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Swamp Monster
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Semi-intelligent humanoid creature covered in moss and vines, with natural camouflage
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Swamp Monster

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Swanmay
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A rare and graceful type of fey shapeshifter that transforms between humanoid and swan forms
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Swanmay

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Sylph
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A feminine fey creature of an aerial nature, appearing as a beautiful woman with dragonfly-like wings and faintly bluish skin
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Sylph

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Syring

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Syring

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Syring Juggernaut

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Tapper

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Tapper

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Telethia
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A large dual-headed beast of magical nature with two pairs of blue glistening wings on a powerful, iridescent body
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Telethia

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Tendriculos
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Voracious plant-like creature that can rear up to 15 feet tall
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Tendriculos

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Tentacled Horror
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A roughly 50-foot diameter mass of hundreds of thick wriggling tentacles
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Tentacled Horror

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Terror Bird
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A flightless prehistoric bird weighing around 800 pounds with a massive beak
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Terror Bird

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Thulid
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Highly intelligent man-like creature with a squid-like visage and four to ten tentacles surrounding a beak-like mouth
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Thulid

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Thulid, Great Brain
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A monstrous, immobile brain ringed by many dexterous but weak tentacles
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Thulid, Great Brain

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Thunderbird
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Rare, intelligent giant eagle with electric-blue coloration and crackling static electricity

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Tick, Giant

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Tommyknocker

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Torok
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Unnaturally agile forest-dwelling tall and slender bird-like humanoids
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Torok

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Trapper

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Trelanx

fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Similar to mermen, but larger and significantly more powerful
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Triton

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Trobold

fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A shadowy relative of the common troll, an embodiment of the element of shadow

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Turtle, Giant Snapping

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Tusker

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Tusker

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Twilight Hound
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A large two-headed canine from another plane with a serpentine tail
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Twilight Hound

fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A colder climate variant of the chimera with arctic tiger, mountain ram, and ice dragon parts
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Tymera

fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A massive member of the terror-bird family (Phorusrhacidae) of bipedal flightless birds
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Tyrannobeak

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Ursavis

fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Dwarf-sized purple-skinned creatures with cat-like ears and dodger-blue hair, cheerful and helpful but easily dominated
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Ushac

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Vermen

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Vermen

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Violet Fungus

fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A strange kind of wild water elemental which hates living creatures, seeking to drown them

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Wayai Otter

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Whippersnapper
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Amphibious predators that look like a cross between an eel and a frog
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Whippersnapper

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Wick Warden
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: Ghostly figures of men cursed to patrol age-old roadways
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Wick Warden

fabio:hasPart.dc:title: Will-o'-Wisp
fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A faintly-glowing sphere of light easily mistaken for a lantern

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Wind Walker

fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A winged hybrid creature incorporating features of rabbits, deer, squirrels, and wolves

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Wolverine

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Worg

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Worm Man

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Wug

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Xorn

fabio:hasPart.schema:description: A poisonous fungus that releases deadly spores when disturbed
fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Yellow Mold

fabio:hasPart.schema:name: Yeti
